test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 19 Mar 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: A, B and C complete a task in 8 days. A or B alone can complete the same task in 20 days. In how many days can C alone complete the same task?
solution:
**Given:**

A, B, and C complete a task in 8 days.

A alone or B alone can complete the task in 20 days.

**Formula Used:**

Work rate = 1 / Time taken

Combined work rate = Work rate of A + Work rate of B + Work rate of C

**Calculation:**

Work rate of A + B + C = 1 / 8

Work rate of A = 1 / 20
